sentences.en: The heavy rain compelled us to put off our departure.
sentences.zh: 大雨迫使我们推迟出发。

sentences.en: All the arrangements should be made prior to our departure.
sentences.zh: 在我们出发之前，所有安排都应该做好。

sentences.en: With the weather getting worse, the departure was put off.
sentences.zh: 天气越来越糟，出发时间被推迟了。

senses.zh: 离开，出发；偏离，背离；起程，启程
